views.rationale: Q3 2017 capitalized software costs fell to $93 million from $118 million in Q3 2016, indicating lower expense and potential earnings boost next quarter
Operating margin rose to 10.7% for the nine months ended Sep 30 2017 versus 5.1% a year earlier, suggesting stronger profitability
Third‑quarter 2017 sales rose 25% to $11.413 billion from $9.160 billion in Q3 2016, indicating robust top‑line growth
Net income increased to $1.952 billion in Q3 2017 from $1.283 billion a year earlier (≈52% rise), reflecting improved earnings
Revenue grew 24% year over year to $27.8 billion, with Google segment up 23% and Other Bets up 53%.
Net revenues in Financial Advisory were $911 million, 38% higher than the third quarter of 2016, driving a 26% rise in pre‑tax earnings.
Worldwide sales reached $56.3 billion, a 4.6% increase year over year, with acquisitions adding a 3.0% boost.
Microsoft's strategy to build best-in-class platforms and productivity services for an intelligent cloud and an intelligent edge infused with artificial intelligence may lead to modest growth.
